description: Client-side script for Purchase Order form in ERPNext, handling form setup, actions, and custom button logic.

classes.name: PurchaseOrderController
classes.description: Controller class for Purchase Order form, extending BuyingController with custom actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for custom buttons in the Purchase Order form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refresh logic for Purchase Order form, managing button visibility and actions based on document status.

methods.name: get_items_from_open_material_requests
methods.description: Fetch and link open material requests to the purchase order.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validation before saving, setting schedule date.

methods.name: has_unsupplied_items
methods.description: Check if there are any unsupplied items in the order.

methods.name: make_stock_entry
methods.description: Create stock entry for transferring raw materials to supplier.

methods.name: make_purchase_receipt
methods.description: Create a purchase receipt from the purchase order.

methods.name: make_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Create a purchase invoice from the purchase order.

methods.name: add_from_mappers
methods.description: Add buttons to map data from other documents like Material Request and Supplier Quotation.

methods.name: items_add
methods.description: Copy schedule date to new item rows.

methods.name: unhold_purchase_order
methods.description: Resume a purchase order that was on hold.

methods.name: hold_purchase_order
methods.description: Put a purchase order on hold with reason.

methods.name: delivered_by_supplier
methods.description: Mark purchase order as delivered by supplier.

methods.name: items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Set schedule date when form is rendered.
